title: GgenIgniter.Receipt
description: One line of a `<base_dir>/.ggen_igniter/receipts/<yyyy-mm-dd>.jsonl` receipt log, as emitted by GgenIgniter.Receipt.to_json_map/1 (lib/ggen_igniter/receipt.ex). Updated 2026-08-27 (Wave1 integration) to include the PRD v2 additive fields (schema_version/tool_version/operation/inputs/queries/engine/outputs/skipped_outputs/commands/source_hash/plan_hash/pre_state_hash/result_hash/parent_hash/receipt_hash/completed_at) GgenIgniter.Receipt.new/2 now populates -- see that module's moduledoc.

id.description: Generated by GgenIgniter.Receipt.generate_id/0: "rcpt_" followed by 16 lowercase hex chars (8 random bytes, Base16-encoded).

recipe_key.description: The (template_path, out_template) identity built by GgenIgniter.Manifest.recipe_key/2, or null for a receipt with no associated recipe (e.g. an early refusal before a recipe was resolved).

standing.description: One of the five real, closed-set standing atoms enforced by GgenIgniter.Receipt.new/1 -- @standings in lib/ggen_igniter/receipt.ex.

pre_run_hash.description: "sha256:" + 64 lowercase hex chars, built by hash_entries/1 / hash_files/1 over the exact file set this attempt touched. null when nothing was ever actuated (a :refused receipt records no hash).

post_run_hash.description: Same format as pre_run_hash. On a :compensated or :build_broken receipt, post_run_hash == pre_run_hash is the real, checkable claim that compensation restored prior state.

events.description: Free-form event records accumulated during the attempt (e.g. {"id": "ev_...", "activity": "ACTUATION_STARTED", ...}). No fixed schema is enforced on individual event shape by receipt.ex itself, so this schema only constrains the container to an array of objects.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation, present on refusal/compensation/failure standings; null on a clean :alive receipt.

metadata.description: Free-form standing-specific detail (e.g. for :compensation_failed: which paths could not be restored and why).

schema_version.description: PRD v2: struct/schema version this receipt was written under. Defaults to "1".

tool_version.description: PRD v2: this application's own release version (Mix.Project.config()[:version]) at the time this receipt was built.

operation.description: PRD v2: free-form label for which operation produced this receipt.

inputs.description: PRD v2: free-form list of real inputs this attempt consumed.

queries.description: PRD v2: free-form list of real queries this attempt ran.

engine.description: PRD v2: the query engine name used for this attempt.

outputs.description: PRD v2: free-form list of real outputs this attempt produced.

skipped_outputs.description: PRD v2: free-form list of outputs this attempt deliberately left unchanged.

commands.description: PRD v2: free-form list of real subprocess commands this attempt ran (e.g. mix compile).

source_hash.description: PRD v2: sha256:<hex> digest of the real source this attempt was built from.

plan_hash.description: PRD v2: sha256:<hex> digest of the real admitted plan for this attempt.

pre_state_hash.description: PRD v2: sha256:<hex> digest of real pre-attempt state, distinct from pre_run_hash's file-scoped hash.

result_hash.description: PRD v2: sha256:<hex> digest of this attempt's real result.

parent_hash.description: PRD v2: the immediately-prior receipt's own receipt_hash for this recipe_key, forming an append-only chain -- null for the first/rootless receipt.

receipt_hash.description: PRD v2: sha256:<hex> digest over this receipt's own content (via GgenIgniter.Receipt.compute_receipt_hash/1), minus this field itself.

completed_at.description: PRD v2: ISO8601 UTC timestamp this attempt was marked complete, distinct from finished_at.
